async def act(page):
    import asyncio
    # Locate the 'Project name' textbox using the exact role and name from the accessibility tree
    project_name_input = page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Project name')
    # Clear the existing text and fill with the new title
    await project_name_input.clear()
    await project_name_input.fill('Not an interesting site')
    # Locate the first 'Save changes' button in the main area
    save_button = page.get_by_role('main').get_by_role('button', name='Save changes').first
    # Wait for the button to be visible and enabled
    await save_button.wait_for(state='visible', timeout=10000)
    # Check if the button is enabled, if not, wait a bit
    if not await save_button.is_enabled():
        await asyncio.sleep(2)
    await save_button.click()
    # Wait for the save operation to complete and page to update
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Additional wait to ensure changes are saved
    # Return a result indicating the action was performed
    return 'Project title updated to "Not an interesting site".'
